# Product management and operations

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py. Edit the YAML source, not this file. -->

**Department id:** `product`  
**Mission:** Convert validated problems into testable scope, measurable outcomes and a roadmap people can execute.

## Startup stage

One founder is the product manager; product operations is a shared spreadsheet and the memory ledger. Business development sits with the CEO.

## Agents operating in this department

`product-lead`, `product-manager`, `cpo-product`

## Roles

### Product manager

Role id: `product-manager`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Define the product so that a developer, a tester and a product owner build the same thing. |
| Scope of responsibility | Thesis, PRD, user stories, acceptance criteria, analytics plan, validation plan. |
| Core activities | Write problem statements without solutions; Write PRD and acceptance criteria; Define analytics events; Plan validation experiments |
| Inputs | Research findings; Opportunity assessment; Design research |
| Outputs and deliverables | PRD; Acceptance criteria; Analytics plan; Validation plan |
| Decisions it can make | Requirement detail; Story slicing |
| Decisions requiring approval | MVP boundary by product lead; thesis by CPO |
| Collaborating roles | design; engineering; research; qa |
| Reporting relationship | product-lead |
| KPIs | Requirements changed after build start; Criteria traceable to tests; Hypotheses validated |
| Quality expectations | Given/When/Then criteria; non-goals explicit; states and permissions covered |
| Tools and resources | PRD template; Acceptance criteria template |
| Common failure modes | Vague criteria; Everything P0; Solution embedded in problem |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | Scope |

### Product strategist

Role id: `product-strategist`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Connect the product roadmap to the business strategy and the evidence. |
| Scope of responsibility | Product vision, roadmap, bets, portfolio decisions. |
| Core activities | Translate strategy into product bets; Sequence roadmap by learning value; Define success metrics |
| Inputs | Strategy memo; Research; Metrics |
| Outputs and deliverables | Product strategy; Roadmap with hypotheses |
| Decisions it can make | Roadmap sequencing proposal |
| Decisions requiring approval | CPO |
| Collaborating roles | strategy; product; design |
| Reporting relationship | cpo |
| KPIs | Learning per release; Metric movement |
| Quality expectations | Each roadmap item names the hypothesis it tests |
| Tools and resources | Roadmap template |
| Common failure modes | Feature roadmaps without hypotheses |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | Roadmap |

### Product operations

Role id: `product-operations`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Keep product process, data and tooling reliable so decisions are fast and traceable. |
| Scope of responsibility | Analytics instrumentation quality, feedback intake, release notes process, decision records. |
| Core activities | Maintain feedback triage; Verify analytics data quality; Keep decision log current |
| Inputs | Feedback; Analytics; Release plans |
| Outputs and deliverables | Triage board; Data quality report; Decision log |
| Decisions it can make | Process details |
| Decisions requiring approval | None |
| Collaborating roles | customer-success; engineering; research |
| Reporting relationship | product-lead |
| KPIs | Feedback triaged within SLA; Analytics defects found |
| Quality expectations | Decisions recorded with evidence ids |
| Tools and resources | Memory ledger; Triage template |
| Common failure modes | Loudest customer as market; Broken analytics trusted |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | execute |
| Human approval requirements | None |
